name: Go My Way 2 full three-part tablature reference
notes: Reference transcribed from the user-supplied bass, rhythm, and octave-lead screenshots. This fixture is diagnostic training ground truth and does not replace any locked green baseline.

rhythm.referenceDescription: Open-position Em riff. G-string fret 2 full bend and release, open-string movement, D-string fret 2, and fret-3 double-stop endings.

lead.referenceDescription: Octave-higher lead around frets 12-14 with full bends, releases, and palm-muted repeated notes.

bass.referenceDescription: Bass riff centred on frets 5 and 7, with rests/dead notes and a later slide into fret 14.
